reason: I'd want to know who stands behind the colour-coding before I trust it with my husband's cholesterol. A green or red label from an app I've never heard of is just a guess to me, and I already order grilled fish and salads without thinking, so I'd probably just keep doing that.
objection: Is this advice from an actual doctor or dietitian? If nobody qualified checked the ratings, I wouldn't rely on them.
would_change_my_mind: A named dietitian or doctor behind the ratings, plus a clear note on how the green, yellow and red calls are made. I'd also try the free first scan before paying anything.
